question: Can TDCC 400-lot-plus ownership concentration be interpreted as same-cadence institutional evidence inside institutionalScore?
evidence: Formal institutionalScore adds 0.15*chipConcentration (max 15) alongside daily/3-session institutional flow terms.
TDCC parser defines chipConcentration as 400-lot-plus holding ratio and explicitly states weekly data; not main-force or institutional identity.
Parser preserves chipAsOfDate and chipDefinition upstream and rejects TDCC rows older than 14 calendar days for the scan date.
After-market scan requires a TDCC quality snapshot for marketDate and merges its per-symbol fields before Formal scoring.
Prospective trade research snapshot serialization preserves chipConcentration but does not preserve chipAsOfDate/chipDefinition, so the row cannot self-authenticate ownership vintage/cadence.
falsification: A weekly ownership level is not a daily institutional-flow observation and must not be described as same-day institutional conviction.
Repeated daily use of an unchanged weekly level does not create new independent evidence; outcome inference must cluster/deduplicate by TDCC vintage when studying this component.
400-lot-plus holders are identity-agnostic; passive/index/institutional/strategic/other large holders cannot be separated from chipConcentration alone.
No outcome evidence was inspected, so usefulness or sign of the ownership component remains UNKNOWN.

safeResearchContract.cadenceRule: Do not count multiple scanDates sharing one chipAsOfDate as independent ownership-vintage observations.

engineering.classB: Adding chipAsOfDate/chipDefinition to shared prospective research persistence/runtime serialization if no isolated path exists.
